preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the sequence.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(1 <= int(x) < 2**60 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers b_1, ..., b_n, each satisfying 1 ≤ b_i < 2^60.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output is exactly 'No'. Otherwise, output is 'Yes' followed by a valid permutation on the next line.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and (b_prime := [int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()]) and len(b_prime) == n and sorted(b_prime) == sorted(b)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the second line contains a permutation b'_1, ..., b'_n of the input sequence b, preserving the multiset of values.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and (a := [0] * (n + 1)) and all((a[i] := a[i - 1] ^ b_prime[i - 1]) < a[i + 1] for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: The sequence a_i = b'_1 ⊕ ... ⊕ b'_i must be strictly increasing for all i from 1 to n-1.
